summary: The accepted game still refuses life saving at step448. A candidate reaches the amulet reprieve in three matching independent recordings, but source review found incomplete done() branches, an incorrect paranoid-death query after genocide, an outdated monster-planning recovery model, and a missing current-form message after polymorphed survival.

source.branch: C end.c done()1081-1103 enters when u.uprops[LIFESAVED].extrinsic is true and how <= GENOCIDED, after the status/death bookkeeping has set mortality and HP to zero. In source order it prints "But wait...", makeknown(AMULET_OF_LIFE_SAVING), the sight-dependent medallion line, the CHOKING vomit line when applicable, "You feel much better!", and the dust line; consumes uamul with useup() when present; calls adjattrib(A_CON, -1, TRUE), then savelife(how). GENOCIDED prints its still-genocided line; every other how formats the killer for LL_LIFESAVE, sets survive, and returns through the killer-clear path instead of really_done(). C savelife()704-756 then restores level/HP, hunger and fatal sickness state, multi/context, lava trap, status/cursor and monster-attachment state in source order. The assigned DIED witness takes this branch before the wizard Die? query. The current JS branch at end.js:638-642 refuses before all side effects.
callers: C mhitu.c mattacku()491-947 reaches hitmu()1144-1267, mdamageu()1902-1927, and done_in_by()1925; monmove.c dochug()965-972 is the monster-turn caller. JS allmain.js advanceElapsedTurn()1238-1255 runs the same movemon/movemon_singlemon path, js/mhitu.js hitmu()1415 calls mdamageu(), and js/mhitu.js mdamageu()1461-1496 calls done_in_by() on the live pass.

C hack.c losehp()4279-4288 is the other direct DIED funnel: after HP drops below one it sets the killer, emits urgent "You die...", and calls done(DIED). JS hack.js losehp()1211-1255 preserves that call, so the end.c life-saving arm must be usable from both monster damage and hero-side lethal damage.

C end.c done_in_by()185-344 emits the regular "You die...", builds svk.killer and calls done() at342; js/end.js done_in_by()327-461 is its production counterpart. The life-saving return must leave this caller alive with the killer reset and without entering really_done().

C cmd.c puton dispatches do_wear.c doputon()2454-2469 -> accessory_or_armor_on()2209-2428 -> Amulet_on()963-1087 -> setworn(), which sets the LIFESAVED extrinsic. JS cmd.js admits puton at1812 and dispatches doputon()5098-5099; js/do_wear.js accessory_or_armor_on()2576-2887 reaches Amulet_on(), so the prior end.js comment that no command can equip the amulet is stale. The assigned input includes takeoff/puton before the lethal turn.
dependencies: C invent.c useup()1321-1333 -> useupall()1310-1317 -> setnotworn() removes the worn amulet and its LIFESAVED extrinsic before object deallocation. JS invent.js useup()5006-5016 requires a setNotWorn hook for a worn object; wire the do_wear.js setwornEnv()/worn.js setnotworn() contract, including cancelDoff and monsterUnseesProperty hooks, and pass any live inventory-refresh hook required by perm_invent.

C hack.h makeknown(x)1530 expands to o_init.c discover_object(x, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE); JS end.js already imports discover_object(). Preserve the source discovery ledger, inventory update and Wisdom exercise draw (rn2(19) when the amulet type is not already known) rather than annotating or inventing a draw.

C attrib.c adjattrib()117-199 changes ABASE/AMAX and can draw rn2() below the racial minimum, resets exercise and marks botl; msgflg TRUE suppresses the feeling text. JS attrib.js adjattrib()1137-1234 is asynchronous and requires an encumberMessage operation for an in-moveloop Constitution change, so done() must supply the existing pickup.js encumber_msg() boundary and preserve await order.

C end.c savelife() consumes minuhpmax(), setuhpmax(), ACURR(), init_uhunger(), reset_utrap(), curs_on_u(), endmultishot(), expels() and unstuck(). JS end.js savelife()221-300 has the ordinary restoration but still explicitly refuses make_sick() for one-turn sickness, expels() while swallowed, and the stuck-monster release/unstuck arm. Keep those source gaps explicit or carry their callees in the same span; do not silently turn them into completed life-saving behavior.

C end.c formatkiller() and livelog_printf(LL_LIFESAVE, "averted death (%s)", killbuf) at1098-1101 are consumed after savelife(); JS topten.js formatkiller() and pline.js livelog_printf() already own the equivalent state, so preserve the LL_LIFESAVE chronicle entry and clear killer.name/format only after the survival path is complete.

The JS planning caller js/mhitu.js mdamageu()1466-1491 currently simulates every wizard/discover lethal hit as the Die? refusal and raises MonsterDeathPlanningError for other modes. A complete lifesaver path must make the clone/live contract account for uprops[LIFESAVED].extrinsic, consume/clear that one-shot property in the clone, apply the source-defined savelife recovery through clone-compatible canonical owners without terminal operations, and avoid allowing a second planned death to reuse the spent amulet.
